title: Two ways to answer: only the strategy you wrote is marked

drive.text: The pre-protein is a monomer of about 30 kDa. After cleavage there is a peak for the 18 kDa protease and peaks near 10 kDa and 50 kDa, which are monomeric B and dimeric A.
Label the RNA so it can be seen on the gel, titrate increasing amounts of protein C against each RNA and look for supershifts, then compare the supershift patterns of the two RNAs.
